_schema_notes.coverage: Authoritative schema for all DID formats — DD Form 1664 (pre-2014) and free-text (post-2014 MIL-STD-963C)
_schema_notes.did_format: Set to 'dd_form_1664' or 'free_text'. Determines which fields are expected to be populated.
_schema_notes.963c_compliant: True if the DID was prepared under MIL-STD-963C (2014 or later). False for older DIDs.
_schema_notes.reserved_fields: Fields marked RESERVED are present in one format but not the other. Always include them — set to empty string or empty array when not applicable.
_schema_notes.preparation_instructions: Official MIL-STD-963C name for what was previously called 'requirements'. Contains the numbered sections of the DID. All section numbers are normalized to strictly numeric dot-notation (1, 1.1, 1.1.1). Letter-based source numbering (2.a, 3.1.b) is converted to numeric equivalents (2.1, 3.1.2).
_schema_notes.asterisk: True if the requirement number is followed by * in the source document (conditional requirement).

title: Test Procedure
summary: The Test Procedure identifies the step-by-step testing operations, equipment, conditions, parameters, and pass/fail criteria for developmental, qualification, or acceptance testing.
use_relationship:
The test procedure identifies the step-by-step testing operations to be performed on items undergoing developmental, qualification, or acceptance testing. It identifies items to be tested, the test equipment and support required, the test conditions to be imposed, the parameters to be measured, and the pass/fail criteria against which the test results will be measured. The document is a compilation of individual test procedures for related elements of a system, subsystem, or equipment.
This Data Item Description (DID) contains the format and content preparation instructions for each tech data product generated by the specific and discrete task requirement as delineated in the contract.
This DID is applicable to contracts requiring tests to be performed for the purpose of developmental or environmental evaluation, acceptance testing, and item qualification testing.
This DID supersedes DI-NDTI-80603.
distribution_statement: DISTRIBUTION STATEMENT A: Approved for public release; distribution is unlimited.

preparation_instructions.title: Format
preparation_instructions.content: The test procedures shall be in contractor's format on 8 1/2 x 11 inch paper. It shall be bound in such a manner that pages may be removed or inserted without damage or mutilation.

preparation_instructions.title: Content
preparation_instructions.content: The test procedure shall contain the following:

children.title: Cover and title page
children.content: The following information shall be included on the cover and title page:

children.title: Type of procedure
children.content: Including purpose (e.g., first article test, developmental evaluation, qualification, environmental (specify), acceptance, or other)

children.title: Identification of the system, subsystem, or equipment to be tested.
Record of changes
children.content: A record of change pages shall be included to provide for tracking of changes to the test procedures.

children.title: Table of contents
children.content: A table of contents is required when more than one test procedure is included in the test procedures document. It shall identify the page location of each procedure number, procedure title, and related equipment nomenclature.

children.title: Body of document
children.content: For each test procedure, the following information is required.

children.title: Procedure number
children.content: Each procedure shall have a unique number assigned to it.

children.title: Title of procedure
children.content: The title should relate to the purpose of the test.

children.title: Introduction
children.content: The following shall be addressed in the introduction:

children.title: Purpose of test
children.content: (As specified in the contract tasking document).

children.title: System, subsystem, or equipment to be tested
children.content: The following identification shall be provided.

children.title: Type of test item (prototype, production item, laboratory model, etc)
Test requirements
children.content: Included the following, each related to the prescribing contract requirement paragraph (specification, standard, plan, or work statement)

children.title: Required tests, and parameters to be measured.
Performance requirements, acceptance of compliance limits, and environmental criteria.
Referenced documents
children.content: A list by title, number, date, and source of those documents cited in the test procedure.

children.title: Required test equipment
children.content: Includes the following for each piece of test equipment required to perform the procedure:

children.title: Range or spectrum of measurements required
Table of tests
children.content: This table lists each test performed under the procedure in the sequence it is to be performed, identified to the procedure paragraph and the related specification/contract requirement.

children.title: Step-by-step procedure
children.content: The following shall be included for each step of the test procedure:

children.title: Test set-up diagrams, including test equipment connections.
Test item operating limits and test conditions to be imposed.
Step-by-step operations to obtain the required data.
Caution and safety warnings as appropriate.
Data sheets
children.content: Data sheets shall be included with the procedure, or be separately attached at the end of all procedures. They shall provide for:

children.title: Identification of item tested, including model and serial numbers.
Identification of required or objective performance values, with tolerances.
Signature of technician or inspector performing the tests.
Support requirements
children.content: Any special support requirement would be included in this section, such as:

children.title: Use of special facilities or test ranges.
Unusual electrical, hydraulic, pneumatic, etc, requirements
